lessons_used: Helpful changes: Adoption visual enhancements (compact photo grids, style selectors, pre-upload inspection), split-view path layouts, session safeguard hints, clear desktop control hints/copy, compact welcome dashboards, post-waiting auth reorders, and waiting tip carousels/readiness hints.

Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners, pre-adoption photo prep screens, pre/post-certificate sign-in reorders, path speed callouts/headlines, story scroll intros, and instant activation incentives.

No clear effect seen: Audio and background notifications, adoption incentive badges, account persistence verification flows, waiting progress overlays/checklists, and carousel or two-column path layouts.

Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspection, photo quality callouts, compact welcome dashboards, clear desktop control copy, post-waiting auth reorders, path reassurance hints, and session safeguard hints.

Predictions were too high: Desktop finish redesigns, preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in stage shifts/reorders, instant activation incentives, and all tests resulting in negative performance or no clear effect.

lessons_next: Helpful changes: Adoption photo and style tools (photo quality hints, style selectors, pre-upload inspection, compact photo grids), sign-in session safeguard hints and retrieval flows, clear desktop control hints/copy, compact welcome dashboards, and waiting readiness hints/carousels.

Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns, banners, and taskbar guidance copy, pre-adoption photo prep screens, pre/post-certificate sign-in stage shifts, path speed helper callouts, story scroll intros, and instant activation incentives.

No clear effect seen: Audio and background notifications, adoption certificate incentive badges, account persistence verification flows, two-column or carousel path layouts, and most waiting progress checklists.

Predictions were too low: Gains were underestimated for clear desktop control copy, tray visibility hints, compact welcome dashboards, post-waiting auth reorders, path reassurance hints, and session safeguard hints.

Predictions were too high: Gains were overestimated for desktop finish redesigns, preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in stage shifts, split-view story intros, instant activation incentives, and any tests resulting in negative performance.
